title: Chicago, IL Property Tax Guide: Offices, Dates and Selling With Tax Due
content:
Chicago, IL Property Tax Guide: Offices, Dates and Selling With Tax Due

Cash Home Buyers in Illinois
Cash Offer in 24 Hours
  • Inherited, behind on payments, tenants, repairs: we buy it as-is
  • Zero fees, zero commissions, zero closing costs
  • No obligation: turn the offer down and owe us nothing

Owe Chicago Property Tax? Get a Cash Offer

We buy Chicago houses as-is. The title company pays unpaid tax from the proceeds.

Call or Text  (424) 435-2326


Last updated November 14, 2026. Citations come from Illinois statutes and official agency pages linked in Sources. Where we could not confirm something on an official page, we say so.

Chicago property tax is billed by the offices named below. This guide points to them and explains what happens to unpaid tax when you sell.

Who bills what in Chicago

  • Cook County Assessor's Office handles assessment.
  • Cook County Treasurer's Office bills and collects the tax.

Due dates

Tax Year 2025: 1st installment due Wed April 1, 2026; 2nd installment due Thu October 1, 2026. (Tax Year 2024: Mar 4, 2025 and Dec 15, 2025.). See the official page.

Challenging your assessment

Two-level appeal: Cook County Assessor (online via SmartFile) and Board of Review, each only while the township is open. 2026 Assessor calendar: North Chicago twp open until 11/24/2026; South Chicago until 12/15/2026; Lakeview, Hyde Park, Lake closed (last file dates 7/13, 10/8, 10/29/2026); other Chicago townships not extracted. Board of Review also lists township dates and deadlines.. See the official page.

Tax rate

The official page we opened lists 6.618606 (composite tax rate, percent of equalized assessed value, City of Chicago, tax year 2024) for 2024. See the official page.

Behind on Chicago property tax?
We buy Chicago houses as-is, and the title company pays unpaid tax from the proceeds.
Get My Cash Offer →

How to sell a house in Chicago when you owe property tax

  1. Find out what the title company needs. For an inherited or transferred house, that usually means the recorded deed or the probate paperwork that shows who owns it today.
  2. Get a payoff for any mortgage and the amount of any unpaid property tax. Both are paid from the sale proceeds at closing.
  3. Compare offers on what you net after repairs, commissions and closing costs, not on the headline price.
  4. If you want a fast, simple closing, ask for a written cash offer. We buy houses as-is, with no repairs and no agent commission. See we buy houses in Illinois.

Chicago property tax guide FAQ

When are Chicago property taxes due?

See the due dates section above and confirm with the collector.

What happens to unpaid Chicago property tax when I sell?

The title company pays unpaid tax from the sale proceeds at closing.
